jobs.name: 01_cookie_crumb_first_frame
jobs.prompt: Keep the exact same character identity, hairstyle, outfit, palette, proportions and crisp 2.5D cel-shaded lineart as the reference image. Vertical 9:16 static macro photo of a real photorealistic wooden desk at seated eye level, soft daylight from the right. A real white ceramic coffee mug stands on the left side of frame. The miniature 2.5D cel-shaded chibi girl stands at the center of the desk, about 20 cm tall, roughly one third the height of the mug, filling a large portion of the vertical frame, facing the camera. She hugs one single golden cookie crumb, about the size of her own torso, tightly against her chest with both arms. Proud closed-mouth smile, eyes open and clearly visible. She receives the same ambient daylight as the desk and casts a soft contact shadow under her boots. The desk and mug stay photorealistic and are never cel-shaded. No text, no letters, no captions, no watermark, no extra characters, no hands.
